findings.current: Canada Motor Vehicle Safety Standards in Schedule IV of the Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations

findings.current: EU 2018/858 Ch. XI; ... fines up to EUR 30,000 per non-compliant vehicle in the EU
findings.proposed: Cite Art. 8-9 (market surveillance obligations), Chapter XI (safeguard clauses, Art. 52 ff.) and Art. 85 (Commission administrative fines, max EUR 30 000 per non-compliant vehicle/system/component). Clarify the 30,000 cap is the Commission's fine, separate from Member State penalties (Art. 84).
findings.evidence: regulations/eu-32018r0858.md: 'CHAPTER XI SAFEGUARD CLAUSES'; 'The administrative fines imposed by the Commission ... shall not exceed EUR 30 000 per non-compliant vehicle, system, component or separate technical unit.' (in a later chapter, not Ch. XI)
